findings.description: `@effect/platform-node` (catalog: 4.0.0-rc.112) is declared as a devDependency of `@qadi/features` but is never imported anywhere: no `platform-node` reference exists in `features/step-definitions/`, `features/**/*.steps.test.ts`, or `features/vitest.config.ts`, and no `.feature`/step-definition file exercises an HTTP server. It isn't mentioned in spec/README.md or CONTRIBUTING.md as an intentional placeholder either, unlike the documented typescript/tstyche version gaps elsewhere in the repo.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove `@effect/platform-node` from features/package.json devDependencies (and drop it from the pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog if nothing else in the workspace ends up using it).

findings.description: `@testing-library/react` (^16.3.2) and `happy-dom` (^20.11.1) are repeated as identical literal version strings across packages/devtools/package.json, packages/react/package.json, features/package.json and examples/nextjs-newsroom/package.json, instead of being added to the pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog the way effect/react/react-dom/vitest/typescript already are. Nothing enforces the four copies stay in sync if one is bumped without the others — the exact drift-prevention problem the catalog exists to solve for the other shared deps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add `@testing-library/react` and `happy-dom` to the pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog and switch the four consuming package.json files to `catalog:`.

findings.description: Within the same devDependencies block, `prisma` is pinned to an exact version (`7.10.0`, line 52) while its companion `@prisma/client` uses a caret range (`^7.10.0`, line 51). These two packages are published together by Prisma and are expected to stay in lockstep (a `@prisma/client` minor bump resolving ahead of the pinned `prisma` CLI is the classic way the two drift apart), so the two pinning styles sitting side by side in one file is an avoidable inconsistency.
findings.suggestedFix: Pin both to the same exact version (`7.10.0`) or both with the same caret range, whichever matches this repo's general preference for exact pins on dev tooling.

findings.description: `@types/node` is pinned to `^25.7.0` (also in features/package.json:25 and examples/nextjs-newsroom/package.json:30) while every package's `engines.node` and the CI matrix's floor leg (.github/workflows/check.yml:48, "20.19.0") require only Node >=20.19.0. Editors and `tsc` will therefore permit calls to Node 25/26-only APIs that aren't guaranteed present on the documented minimum runtime; a real such call would still be caught by the CI matrix's 20.19.0 leg at test time, so the risk is narrow, but the type surface itself doesn't reflect the floor.
findings.suggestedFix: Either raise engines.node to match the @types/node major, or pin @types/node to a ^20.x range matching the documented floor.
